greet.text: {player}! Did you hear? Elder Mo said I have a fire root. One day I'll fly on a sword. ...Will you come with me?

choices.label: Share a Spirit Herb with her.
Ask how her cultivation is going.

together.text: We sat by the Spirit Spring for a month. She chattered the whole time, but your qi feels steadier.

herb.text: For me? ...Thank you. I won't forget this.

progress.text: I've reached {npc_realm}! What about you? You're at {player_realm}, right?

mocked.text: ...Fine. We'll see who's laughing in a hundred years.

rival.text: Oh. It's you. I'm at {npc_realm} now. Don't get in my way.
